usage: Phoenix HEEx function components, one DNA each.

elixir_components.title: CTA — Big Top Bill
elixir_components.description: A 1910 big-top bill for Latch: one-week-only starburst seal, wood-type Rye headline, a single red ticket-button.

elixir_components.title: Features Bento — Zine Spread
elixir_components.description: Photocopied zine spread: features as cut-and-paste cells pinned at odd angles with tape strips and marker underlines.

elixir_components.title: Footer — Lighthouse
elixir_components.description: The lighthouse footer: a foghorn-sized Anton wordmark under signal-red rules, columns set like tide charts, honest small print.

elixir_components.title: Hero — Factory Floor
elixir_components.description: Offset industrial hero: giant Anton headline slammed against a rotated safety-orange serial plate, spec manifest down the side.

elixir_components.title: Navbar — Strict Grid
elixir_components.description: Information architecture as navigation: numbered links on a strict hairline grid, a mono clock, one red action — nothing decorative.

elixir_components.title: Pricing — Lab Ledger
elixir_components.description: A scientist's ledger page: three plans ruled on graph paper, the recommended one circled in red pen with handwritten marginalia.

elixir_components.title: Stats — Terminal Readout
elixir_components.description: A machine reporting on itself: Latch's numbers as phosphor-green terminal readouts after a typed command, amber warnings included.

elixir_components.title: Testimonial Wall — Guest Book
elixir_components.description: A Showa coffee-house guest-book wall: testimonial notes clipped along a brass rail at varying heights, lamplight typography.
